Class SessionRecorder

java.lang.Object
com.example.export.SessionRecorder
All Implemented Interfaces:
TelemetryObserver
public class SessionRecorder extends Object implements TelemetryObserver
Author:
Ubayd Razack Observer that keeps the events for the current session only. A session starts when a project opens and ends when it closes; finish() hands back everything recorded and resets for the next session. The student ID is read from BlueJ's preferences each time a report is made.

    • onEvent

      public void onEvent(TelemetryEvent event)
      Records an event if a session is running. A EventType.PROJECT_OPENED event also starts a session, so it does not matter whether this or the BlueJ listener hears about the project first.
      Specified by:
      onEvent in interface TelemetryObserver
      Parameters:
      event - the event that was just published
